title: Writing Practice — Cooking at home
description: Academic Task 1: data report. Task 2: essay. Suggested time: 60 minutes.

tasks.prompt:
The table shows adults who prepared a main meal at home at least four days a week in three age groups in 2015, 2020 and 2025.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.

Some people want schools to help children develop cooking skills, while others think limited school time should be used for academic subjects.

Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.
